title: Jared Goff backs Dan Campbell's decision to go for it deep in Lions' own end

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jared Goff backs Dan Campbell's decision to go for it deep in Lions' own end
sources.description: The Lions went for it on fourth-and-1 in a tie game with 4:53 left, and Jahmyr Gibbs was stopped for a 2-yard loss.
